read.thesis: Organic sales +4.0% on volume (+2.4 pts) but core gross margin down 150 bps and a $1.4B after-tax commodity headwind; management held guidance and kept the EPS range wide.

capex.quote: Capital Spending -- 4.5% to 5.5% of net sales, focused on capacity expansion and supply chain optimization efforts.

triggers.label: Commodity headwind 5% → 8% of EPS
triggers.quote: Due to the duration of higher oil prices, we now expect materially higher cost headwinds in Q2 and the second half of fiscal 2027.

triggers.label: Organic volume +2.4 pts, H1 ~3%
triggers.quote: we expect H1 to be at about 3% organic sales growth.

triggers.label: Top US customers holding/growing share 70%+
triggers.quote: over 70% of our top U. S. Customers holding or growing share

guidance.value: ~3% in first half, slight acceleration in second half
guidance.quote: we expect H1 to be at about 3% organic sales growth.
We continue to expect sales growth of 1% to 3%,
our bottom line guidance is for core EPS growth of 0% to 3%, versus prior year
We are forecasting free cash flow productivity at 85% to 90% for the year,
We expect capital spending will be between 4.5% to 5.5% of sales.
a plan to return $15 billion of cash to shareowners in fiscal 2027.
We now expect that our co effective tax rate will be in the range of 20% to 21%.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Organic sales, core EPS, FCF productivity ranges
prior_guidance_check.quote: we are maintaining our fiscal 27 guidance ranges across organic sales core EPS and free cash flow productivity.

red_flags.label: Core gross margin down 150 bps; commodity cost escalating
red_flags.quote: Core Gross Margin -- 50.0%, representing a decrease of 150 basis points due to 140 basis points of higher commodity costs

red_flags.label: Q2 deceleration to ~3% embedded despite easier comps
red_flags.quote: We think 3% is a healthy growth rate within this context, and we know there is volatility quarter over quarter.

evasions.quote: Sorry, I do not want to evade your question, but the confidence I have is that we will be in the range. Where in the range?
I really will not be able to tell you more about future pricing, obviously. I cannot announce pricing
